description: Retained PR #2641 candidate measurements; before the final numerical fixes. These are kernel timings, not model benchmarks.

protocol.reference: Independent FP64 attention on sampled boundary/interior query rows before and after timing; whole-output finiteness check.

aggregation: Each backend latency is the median of the two run medians. TFLOP/s is useful_flops / (median_us * 1e6). Speedup is baseline latency / candidate latency. Geomean weights each shape equally, including both regressions.
